change: Resume final signed-DMG notarization by durable Apple submission ID, bind accepted logs to the submitted bytes, staple and independently verify production archive policy before final checksums.
workflowControls: check signatures and archive contents before any Apple upload
save input bytes and submission ID before waiting
resume pending Apple job without another submit
refuse automatic retry after ambiguous upload until an ID is reconciled
bind adopted and original jobs to their accepted log SHA-256
reject service failures, different jobs and different checksums before staple
retain accepted state after staple/policy failure and resume without another submit
reject changed DMG, ZIP, publisher, corrupt state and linked DMG files
exclude concurrent finalizers and invalidate old verification reports
verify final distribution archives and hash the actual final DMG; leave checksum generation to complete package verification
scope: The new workflow tests use real temporary files and simulated Apple service/verification operations. The production CLI has no test override and uses real xcrun, codesign, stapler, syspolicy_check and spctl through the shared archive verifier. Existing native archive tests exercise real DMG/ZIP contents and rejection of unsigned/ad-hoc production artifacts. No Apple acceptance, ticket, signing credential, installed upgrade or production publication is claimed.
